title: 信息日报 2026-08-26

headline.title: OpenAI 自研推理芯片 Jalapeño 首发成绩：速度与效率领先行业
headline.summary: OpenAI 发布自研推理芯片 Jalapeño 的首批测试结果，称其在 AI 推理任务上实现了更高的吞吐量、更低的延迟和更好的能效，为大规模部署现代模型提供了更快、更省电的算力选择。
headline.title_en: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip shows industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
headline.summary_en: OpenAI unveiled the first benchmark results for its custom inference chip, Jalapeño, showing higher throughput, lower latency, and improved power efficiency for modern AI models — offering a faster, more energy-efficient compute option for large-scale deployment.
headline.original_title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
headline.reason: 这是 OpenAI 首款自研推理芯片的公开业绩，直接关系到 AI 算力成本与规模化落地，是当天 AI 基础设施层面最具产业影响力和前瞻性的新闻。
headline.reason_en: This is the first public performance data for OpenAI's custom inference silicon, directly impacting AI compute costs and scalability — the most influential and forward-looking infrastructure story of the day.
